local function SwitchPage(show)
    CarPage.Visible = (show == CarPage)
    MoneyPage.Visible = (show == MoneyPage)
    SettingsPage.Visible = (show == SettingsPage)
    ScrollFrame.Visible = false
    MethodScroll.Visible = false
    CarTabBtn.BackgroundColor3 =
        (show == CarPage) and Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35) or Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
    MoneyTabBtn.BackgroundColor3 =
        (show == MoneyPage) and Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35) or Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
    SettingsTabBtn.BackgroundColor3 =
        (show == SettingsPage) and Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35) or Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
    CarTabBtn.TextColor3 =
        (show == CarPage) and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(0.5,0.5,0.5)
    MoneyTabBtn.TextColor3 =
        (show == MoneyPage) and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(0.5,0.5,0.5)
    SettingsTabBtn.TextColor3 =
        (show == SettingsPage) and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(0.5,0.5,0.5)
end

SearchBox.TextSize = 16

Instance.new("UICorner", SearchBox)
local function UpdateCarList()
    for _, child in ipairs(ScrollFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    local search = string.lower(SearchBox.Text or "")
    local shown = 0
    for _, car in ipairs(cars) do
        local carName = string.lower(car.n)
        if search == "" or string.find(carName, search, 1, true) then
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", ScrollFrame)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 45)
            b.Text = car.n .. " ($" .. tostring(car.p) .. ")"
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            b.TextSize = 15
            b.ZIndex = 101
            Instance.new("UICorner", b)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SelectedCar = car.n
                DropdownBtn.Text = car.n
                ScrollFrame.Visible = false
            end)
            shown = shown + 1
        end
    end
    ScrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, shown * 50)
end
SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    UpdateCarList()
    if SearchBox.Text ~= "" then
        ScrollFrame.Visible = true
    end
end)
DropdownBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)
UpdateCarList()
SpawnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

local moneyLooping = false
MoneyToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    moneyLooping = not moneyLooping
    MoneyToggleBtn.Text =
        moneyLooping and "LOOP MONEY: ON" or "LOOP MONEY: OFF"
    MoneyToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 =
        moneyLooping
        and Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 50)
        or Color3.fromRGB(50, 20, 20)
    if moneyLooping then
        task.spawn(function()
            while moneyLooping do
                GiveMoneyEvent:FireServer(2500, currentMethod)
                task.wait(0.001)
            end
        end)
    end
end)
local antiAfkEnabled = false

end)
Player.Idled:Connect(function()
    if antiAfkEnabled then
        VirtualUser:CaptureController()
        VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
    end
end)
local speeds = {16, 50, 100, 250}
local currentSpeedIdx = 1
SpeedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    currentSpeedIdx = currentSpeedIdx % #speeds + 1
    local s = speeds[currentSpeedIdx]
    if Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        Player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = s
    end
    SpeedBtn.Text =
        "Walkspeed: " .. (s == 16 and "Default" or s)
end)
ExitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    moneyLooping = false
    antiAfkEnabled = false
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
features:
Highway Showdown V2
A clean and simple GUI for Highway Showdown, focused on making vehicle selection easier and faster.

Features:

🚗 Vehicle selection menu
🔎 Real-time car search
📋 Large vehicle list
💰 Vehicle prices displayed
⚡ Quick vehicle spawning
💵 Money utilities
💤 Anti-AFK
🏃 WalkSpeed settings
🎨 Clean dark interface
📑 CARS / MONEY / SETTINGS tabs
🔑 No Key System

Notes:

Some vehicles may not spawn depending on the game's current server-side restrictions.
Features may change as Highway Showdown is updated.

Credits: Slammy
(Script Updated By: Lxx)

Made for Highway Showdown.
Feedback and bug reports are welcome.
